feeTo.mustBe: externally owned account; an EIP-7702 delegation only to an identified delegate holding its recorded code (any other is refused); a designator other than the recorded one is a warning
feeTo.proofOfControl: deployments/fee-address-proof.json: required by the pre gate on the public chain

firstDepositor.mustBe: the address check-depositor.mjs recorded: a dedicated key account, not the fee address, no code, no EIP-7702 delegation, no transaction on the chain before the factory is deployed

openingPrice.minimumReason: At least 0.1 ETH and its USDC at the market price: gas is negligible here (the first deposit cost under 0.001 ETH in every measurement); the floor keeps the pool worth more than a few hundred dollars a side, below which a 100-dollar swap moves the price by tens of percent and the page's quotes are of no use. Inflating the first share is not possible at any size (only the depositing account can mint first, and the pair locks 1,000 share units); the tool also refuses a deposit whose share supply would be under 10^12 units, so that the locked units are at most a billionth of it.
